files.text:
//
// Run GATK4_MUTECT2, getepileupsummaries, calculatecontamination, learnreadorientationmodel and filtermutectcalls for tumor normal or tumor-only analyses
//

include { GATK4_CALCULATECONTAMINATION    } from 'nf-core/gatk4/calculatecontamination'
include { GATK4_FILTERMUTECTCALLS         } from 'nf-core/gatk4/filtermutectcalls'
include { GATK4_GETPILEUPSUMMARIES        } from 'nf-core/gatk4/getpileupsummaries'
include { GATK4_LEARNREADORIENTATIONMODEL } from 'nf-core/gatk4/learnreadorientationmodel'
include { GATK4_MUTECT2                   } from 'nf-core/gatk4/mutect2'

workflow BAM_SOMATIC_VARIANT_CALLING_GATK {
    take:
    ch_input // channel: [ val(meta), path(tumor_input), path(tumor_input_index), path(normal_input), path(normal_input_index)]
    ch_fasta // channel: [ val(meta), path(fasta) ]
    ch_fai // channel: [ val(meta), path(fai), path(gzi) ]
    ch_dict // channel: [ val(meta), path(dict) ]
    ch_alleles // channel: /path/to/alleles
    ch_alleles_tbi // channel: /path/to/alleles/index
    ch_germline_resource // channel: /path/to/germline/resource
    ch_germline_resource_tbi // channel: /path/to/germline/index
    ch_panel_of_normals // channel: /path/to/panel/of/normals
    ch_panel_of_normals_tbi // channel: /path/to/panel/of/normals/index
    ch_interval_file // channel: /path/to/interval/file

    main:

    ch_mutect2_in = ch_input.map{ meta, tumor_input, tumor_input_index, normal_input, normal_input_index ->
        if (normal_input && normal_input_index) {
            [meta, [tumor_input, normal_input], [tumor_input_index, normal_input_index]]
        }
        else {
            [meta, tumor_input, tumor_input_index]
        }
        }
        .combine(ch_interval_file)

    GATK4_MUTECT2(
        ch_mutect2_in,
        ch_fasta,
        ch_fai,
        ch_dict,
        ch_alleles,
        ch_alleles_tbi,
        ch_germline_resource,
        ch_germline_resource_tbi,
        ch_panel_of_normals,
        ch_panel_of_normals_tbi,
    )

    ch_mutect2_vcf = GATK4_MUTECT2.out.vcf
    ch_mutect2_stats = GATK4_MUTECT2.out.stats
    ch_mutect2_tbi = GATK4_MUTECT2.out.tbi
    ch_mutect2_f1r2 = GATK4_MUTECT2.out.f1r2

    // Generate artifactpriors using learnreadorientationmodel on the f1r2 output of GATK4_MUTECT2
    GATK4_LEARNREADORIENTATIONMODEL(ch_mutect2_f1r2)

    ch_artifact_priors = GATK4_LEARNREADORIENTATIONMODEL.out.artifactprior

    // Generate pileup summary tables using getepileupsummaries
    ch_getpileupsummaries_in = ch_input
        .flatMap { meta, tumor_input, tumor_input_index, normal_input, normal_input_index ->
            def result = [
                [[
                    id: "${meta.id}_tumor", // Add unique meta.id to ensure output files from GATK4_GETPILEUPSUMMARIES receive different names for the tumor and normal samples
                    sample_type: 'tumor', // Add sample type to facilitate correct ordering for GATK4_CALCULATECONTAMINATION
                    original_meta: meta],
                tumor_input,
                tumor_input_index]
                ]

            if (normal_input && normal_input_index) {
                result << [
                    [
                        id: "${meta.id}_normal", // Add unique meta.id to ensure output files from GATK4_GETPILEUPSUMMARIES receive different names for the tumor and normal samples
                        sample_type: 'normal', // Add sample type to facilitate correct ordering for GATK4_CALCULATECONTAMINATION
                        original_meta: meta],
                    normal_input,
                    normal_input_index
                    ]
            }

            return result
        }
        .combine(ch_interval_file)


    GATK4_GETPILEUPSUMMARIES(
        ch_getpileupsummaries_in,
        ch_fasta.collect(),
        ch_fai.map { meta, fai, _gzi -> [meta, fai] }.collect(),
        ch_dict.collect(),
        ch_germline_resource.collect(),
        ch_germline_resource_tbi.collect(),
    )

    ch_pileup_table = GATK4_GETPILEUPSUMMARIES.out.table
        .map { meta, table -> [meta.original_meta, table] } // Remove unique meta.id added in ch_getpileupsummaries_in and restore original meta

    // Contamination and segmentation tables created using calculatecontamination on the pileup summary table
    // Use meta.sample_type to order the pileup summary tables as expected by GATK4_CALCULATECONTAMINATION (tumor first, normal second)
    ch_calculatecontamination_in = GATK4_GETPILEUPSUMMARIES.out.table
    .map { meta, table ->
        [ meta.original_meta, meta.sample_type, table ]
    }
    .groupTuple()
    .map { meta, types, tables ->
        def by_type = [types, tables].transpose().collectEntries()
        [ meta, by_type.tumor, by_type.get('normal', []) ]
    }

    GATK4_CALCULATECONTAMINATION(ch_calculatecontamination_in)

    ch_contamination_table = GATK4_CALCULATECONTAMINATION.out.contamination
    ch_segmentation_table = GATK4_CALCULATECONTAMINATION.out.segmentation

    // GATK4_MUTECT2 calls filtered by filtermutectcalls using the artifactpriors, contamination and segmentation tables
    ch_filtermutect_in = ch_mutect2_vcf
        .join(ch_mutect2_tbi, failOnDuplicate: true, failOnMismatch: true)
        .join(ch_mutect2_stats, failOnDuplicate: true, failOnMismatch: true)
        .join(ch_artifact_priors, failOnDuplicate: true, failOnMismatch: true)
        .join(ch_segmentation_table, failOnDuplicate: true, failOnMismatch: true)
        .join(ch_contamination_table, failOnDuplicate: true, failOnMismatch: true)
        .map{ meta, vcf, tbi, stats, artifactprior, segmentation, contamination ->
            [
                meta,
                vcf,
                tbi,
                stats,
                artifactprior,
                segmentation,
                contamination,
                [], // Since the contamination table is provided, the value estimate is not relevant
            ]
        }

    ch_fasta_fai_dict = ch_fasta
        .join(ch_fai.map { meta, fai, _gzi -> [meta, fai] }, failOnDuplicate: true, failOnMismatch: true)
        .join(ch_dict, failOnDuplicate: true, failOnMismatch: true)

    GATK4_FILTERMUTECTCALLS(
        ch_filtermutect_in,
        ch_fasta_fai_dict,
    )

    emit:
    artifact_priors     = ch_artifact_priors // channel: [ val(meta), path(artifactprior) ]
    contamination_table = ch_contamination_table // channel: [ val(meta), path(table) ]
    filtered_stats      = GATK4_FILTERMUTECTCALLS.out.stats // channel: [ val(meta), path(stats) ]
    filtered_tbi        = GATK4_FILTERMUTECTCALLS.out.tbi // channel: [ val(meta), path(tbi) ]
    filtered_vcf        = GATK4_FILTERMUTECTCALLS.out.vcf // channel: [ val(meta), path(vcf) ]
    mutect2_f1r2        = ch_mutect2_f1r2 // channel: [ val(meta), path(f1r2) ]
    mutect2_stats       = ch_mutect2_stats // channel: [ val(meta), path(stats) ]
    mutect2_tbi         = ch_mutect2_tbi // channel: [ val(meta), path(tbi) ]
    mutect2_vcf         = ch_mutect2_vcf // channel: [ val(meta), path(vcf) ]
    pileup_table        = ch_pileup_table // channel: [ val(meta), path(table) ]
    segmentation_table  = ch_segmentation_table // channel: [ val(meta), path(table) ]
}

---
name: "nf-core/bam_somatic_variant_calling_gatk"
description: "Perform variant calling for tumor-normal or tumor-only analyses.\nThe\
  \ f1r2 output of mutect2 is run through learnreadorientationmodel to get the artifact\
  \ priors.\nThe input bam files are run through getpileupsummarries and then calculatecontamination\
  \ to get the contamination and segmentation tables.\nFiltering of the mutect2 output\
  \ vcf is done using filtermutectcalls, artifact priors and the contamination & segmentation\
  \ tables for additional filtering.\n"
keywords:
- "gatk4"
- "mutect2"
- "learnreadorientationmodel"
- "getpileupsummaries"
- "calculatecontamination"
- "filtermutectcalls"
- "variant_calling"
- "tumor_only"
- "filtered_vcf"
components:
- "gatk4/mutect2"
- "gatk4/learnreadorientationmodel"
- "gatk4/getpileupsummaries"
- "gatk4/calculatecontamination"
- "gatk4/filtermutectcalls"
input:
- ch_input:
    description: "The BAM or CRAM input file(s) and corresponding index file(s).\n\
      Input files for the normal sample are optional.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(tumor_input),\
      \ path(tumor_input_index), path(normal_input), path(normal_input_index)]\n"
- ch_fasta:
    description: "The reference fasta file\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(fasta)\
      \ ]\n"
- ch_fai:
    description: "Index of reference fasta file, and the gzip index when the reference\
      \ is compressed\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(fai), path(gzi) ]\n"
- ch_dict:
    description: "GATK sequence dictionary\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(dict) ]\n"
- ch_alleles:
    description: "VCF file to be used for force calling of alleles.\n\nStructure:\
      \ [ path(alleles) ]\n"
- ch_alleles_tbi:
    description: "Index of VCF file of alleles for force calling.\n\nStructure: [\
      \ path(alleles_tbi) ]\n"
- ch_germline_resource:
    description: "Population vcf of germline sequencing, containing allele fractions.\n\
      \nStructure: [ path(germline_resources) ]\n"
- ch_germline_resource_tbi:
    description: "Index file for the germline resource.\n\nStructure: [ path(germline_resources_tbi)\
      \ ]\n"
- ch_panel_of_normals:
    description: "Vcf file to be used as a panel of normals. Optional and should only\
      \ be provided for tumor-only analysis.\n\nStructure: [ path(panel_of_normals)\
      \ ]\n"
- ch_panel_of_normals_tbi:
    description: "Index for the panel of normals. Optional and should only be provided\
      \ for tumor-only analysis.\n\nStructure: [ path(panel_of_normals_tbi) ]\n"
- ch_interval_file:
    description: "File containing intervals.\n\nStructure: [ path(interval_files)\
      \ ]\n"
output:
- artifact_priors:
    description: "File containing artifact-priors to be used by filtermutectcalls.\n\
      \nStructure: [ val(meta), path(artifact_priors) ]\n"
- contamination_table:
    description: "File containing the contamination table.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ path(table) ]\n"
- filtered_stats:
    description: "File containing statistics of the filtermutectcalls run.\n\nStructure:\
      \ [ val(meta), path(stats) ]\n"
- filtered_tbi:
    description: "Tbi file that pairs with filtered vcf.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ path(tbi) ]\n"
- filtered_vcf:
    description: "File containing filtered mutect2 calls.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ path(vcf) ]\n"
- mutect2_f1r2:
    description: "File containing information to be passed to LearnReadOrientationModel.\n\
      \nStructure: [ val(meta), path(f1r2) ]\n"
- mutect2_stats:
    description: "Stats files for the mutect2 vcf\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(stats)\
      \ ]\n"
- mutect2_tbi:
    description: "Indexes of the mutect2_vcf file\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(tbi)\
      \ ]\n"
- mutect2_vcf:
    description: "Compressed vcf file to be used for variant_calling.\n\nStructure:\
      \ [ val(meta), path(vcf) ]\n"
- pileup_table:
    description: "Pileup summary table, kept separate as calculatecontamination needs\
      \ them individually specified. In case of tumor-normal analysis, two entries\
      \ are output - one for the normal sample and one for the tumor sample.\n\nStructure:\
      \ [ val(meta), path(table) ]\n"
- segmentation_table:
    description: "Output table containing segmentation of tumor minor allele fractions.\n\
      \nStructure: [ val(meta), path(table) ]\n"
authors:
- "@GCJMackenzie"
maintainers:
- "@GCJMackenzie"
version: "0.0.0-e78a211"
license: "MIT License"
kind: "Workflow"
requires:
  modules:
  - "nf-core/gatk4/calculatecontamination@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/gatk4/filtermutectcalls@0.0.0-b7e7de8"
  - "nf-core/gatk4/getpileupsummaries@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/gatk4/learnreadorientationmodel@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/gatk4/mutect2@0.0.0-6d1763b"
